name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 5 visits over 39 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 25 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 39 hours starting 2025-10-20, at wavelengths from 1.37 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
